page_title: LIL 3-0 LOR | Lille v Lorient 14/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Pierre Gaillouste is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+2' 3 - 0 What a beauty from just outside the box! Edon Zhegrova (Lille) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom left corner.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' 2 - 0 Goal! Remy Cabella (Lille) has the simplest of tasks to roll the ball into an empty net from close range after a rebound left the keeper stranded. 2:0.
89' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
88' The referee is firm and issues Isaak Toure (Lorient) a deserved yellow card.
87' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Gino Caoki (Lorient), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
84' That will be all from Theo Le Bris who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Gino Caoki (Lorient).
83' Remy Cabella (Lille) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
82' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Lorient was in an offside position.
82' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
79' Half-chance! Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) plays a pass into the box, but Lucas Chevalier reacts well to snuff out the attack.
77' The substitution is prepared. Remy Cabella (Lille) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Yusuf Yazici.
76' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
75' Regis Le Bris has decided to substitute Ayman Kari and he is replaced by Royce Openda (Lorient).
75' Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Tiemoue Bakayoko.
75' Lille take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
74' An attempted cross from Laurent Abergel (Lorient) is cleared. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lorient are going to take it.
72' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) receives a cross in the box and attempts to shoot, but mishits the ball and misses the goal.
72' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Edon Zhegrova (Lille). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

71' Ayman Kari (Lorient) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant low pass, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. That should have been a goalscoring opportunity.
69' Tiago Santos (Lille) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
68' The ball is cleared after Edon Zhegrova (Lille) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
67' Ayman Kari (Lorient) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
66' Jonathan David (Lille) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
65' Benjamin Andre (Lille) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
63' One of the players from Lille times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
63' Angel Gomes (Lille) decides to have a go at goal from the edge of the box, but the wall jumps as one and blocks the free kick. Danger averted!
61' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.

60' A cross is whipped in towards Yusuf Yazici (Lille) on the edge of the six-yard box. He wins the ball but sends his header just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
58' Lille are ruled offside.
57' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) smashes the ball from the mid-range free-kick straight into the defensive wall.
55' Aurelien Pelon (Lorient) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
53' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
51' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper perfectly sets up the defensive wall and his effort is thwarted.
49' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
48' Lille control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' The game is over for Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient). Eli Junior Kroupi comes on for the second half.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' A dangerous looking corner kick from Edon Zhegrova (Lille) is cleared to safety by the defence.

43' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) produces a brilliant low pass into the box, where Jonathan David is already waiting. He attempts to dribble past the defence, but one of the defenders does well to dispossess him.

42' The cross into the penalty area from Edon Zhegrova (Lille) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
41' Tiemoue Bakayoko (Lorient) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
40' Benjamin Andre (Lille) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
37' 1 - 0 The ball is whipped in from the free kick and finds Jonathan David (Lille), who rises and produces an amazing header into the top right corner.
36' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) takes the corner kick, but Yvon Mvogo reads it well and stops the effort.
36' Angel Gomes (Lille) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Now Lille have a corner.
35' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) sends a cross into the box, but Yvon Mvogo comes off his line to gather the ball.
34' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
32' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
31' The free kick from close range, taken by Lille, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
30' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
30' Tiemoue Bakayoko (Lorient) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
29' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
27' Angel Gomes (Lille) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a long-range shot towards the top of the net, Yvon Mvogo makes a decent save to stop the effort.
26' Tiago Santos (Lille) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
25' Lorient enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
22' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) will deliver the corner kick.
22' Benjamin Andre (Lille) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
21' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Yvon Mvogo was alert and made a comfortable save.
21' Pierre Gaillouste blows his whistle after Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Free kick. Lille will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
19' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.

19' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety. The ball goes out of play. Lille are awarded a corner kick.

18' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Yvon Mvogo guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The referee signals a corner kick to Lille.

17' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Tiago Santos (Lille) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
15' Lille are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

13' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) beats the defender to the lofted pass inside the box, but can't control his shot and it flashes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
12' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
11' Ayman Kari (Lorient) makes a rough challenge and Pierre Gaillouste blows his whistle for a foul. Lille are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
10' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
9' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
7' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
5' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Edon Zhegrova (Lille).

4' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom left corner only for Yvon Mvogo to dive and make a save. The referee blows his whistle, Lille are awarded a corner kick.
3' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.

2' Nice move, nice attempt! Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
2' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Tiago Santos (Lille).
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lorient will have the kick-off.
Pierre Gaillouste was nominated as the referee for this game.
